s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with urinary frequency, pelvic pain, and weight loss
salient_findings: Heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion involving the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass in the right retroperitoneal space encasing the right external iliac artery
Tumor with fleshy solid and cystic components, central hemorrhage, and necrosis
key_facts: 54-year-old woman with history of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma
Treated with mastectomy and chemoradiation 4 years earlier
Presenting with urinary frequency, worsening right-sided pelvic pain, and weight loss
MRI of the pelvis showed multiple fibroids and a heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion
Mass was found in the right retroperitoneal space, tracking along the broad ligament
Mass encased the right external iliac artery
Gross specimen was a detached, fragmented, ill-defined mass with fleshy solid and cystic components
Microscopic examination showed tumor invasion from the serosal surface into the myometrium
Tumor comprised sheets of small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios
Frequent mitoses (32 per 10 high-power fields) and pseudo-rosette formation
Immunohistochemical stains showed diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: High-grade tumor with mitoses and necrosis, consistent with leiomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Endometrial stromal sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor invasion into myometrium and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, consistent with endometrial stromal sarcoma

shortlist.label: Uterine carcinosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous mass with fleshy solid and cystic components, possible carcinosarcoma

shortlist.label: Ewing sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, consistent with Ewing sarcoma

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, consistent with desmoplastic small round cell tumor

shortlist.label: Uterine adenosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous mass with fleshy solid and cystic components, possible adenosarcoma

shortlist.label: Uterine metastasis from breast carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma, possible metastasis

shortlist.label: High-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor invasion into myometrium and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, consistent with high-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma

raw.rationale: The patient's history of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma and the presence of a tumor with small, round hyperchromatic cells and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, which is atypical for primary uterine tumors, suggests metastasis from the breast carcinoma

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of typical smooth muscle differentiation and immunohistochemical profile

rejected.label: Endometrial stromal sarcoma
rejected.why: Does not typically show the high mitotic rate and pseudo-rosette formation seen in this case

rejected.label: Uterine carcinosarcoma
rejected.why: Typically contains both carcinomatous and sarcomatous elements, which were not described

rejected.label: Ewing sarcoma
rejected.why: Typically occurs in younger patients and has a distinct immunohistochemical profile with CD99 positivity but also typically expresses FLI-1 and ERG

rejected.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
rejected.why: Typically occurs in the abdominal cavity of young males and has a distinct immunohistochemical profile

rejected.label: Uterine adenosarcoma
rejected.why: Typically contains glandular elements and a distinct immunohistochemical profile

rejected.label: High-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma
rejected.why: Does not typically show the high mitotic rate and pseudo-rosette formation seen in this case
